title: Anthropic千亿IPO落地 后续看什么
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Anthropic raising over $107 billion, topping a record from SpaceX earlier this year.
segments.zh: Anthropic融资超1070亿美元，超过今年早些时候SpaceX的纪录。

segments.en: Mandy Singh of Bloomberg Intelligence joins us now for more. Mandy, the numbers have always been stunning with this company. They are even more stunning in the last 24 hours. They are. And look, when you think about the valuation,
segments.zh: 彭博情报的Mandy Singh加入我们。Mandy，这家公司的数字一直惊人，过去24小时更惊人。是的，看估值，

segments.en: right now we are talking about maybe the company is trading at 10 times forward sales.
segments.zh: 目前公司交易估值可能是远期销售额的10倍。

segments.en: And the fact that they have raised over $100 billion with this IPO allows them to be comfortable with the compute commitments they have. So that is the big risk when it comes to a company like
segments.zh: 他们通过IPO融资超1000亿美元，能从容应对算力承诺。这是这类公司的大风险，

segments.en: Anthropic that has, you know, up to $900 billion in commitments, would it be able to pay for that?
segments.zh: Anthropic有高达9000亿美元的承诺，能付得起吗？

segments.en: And there is no cash burn. They have raised this $100 billion plus amount. They have over $200 billion on the balance sheet after this event. So from that perspective, the business model
segments.zh: 而且没有现金消耗。他们融资超1000亿美元，事件后资产负债表超2000亿美元。从这个角度看，商业模式

segments.en: does look very sustainable here. Mandy, we can talk a lot about the business model, the fundamentals.
segments.zh: 看起来非常可持续。Mandy，我们可以多谈商业模式和基本面。

segments.en: Can we talk about the tentacles? What's the locker look like in the coming weeks, the coming months and how much pressure might be on this name from the other side?
segments.zh: 能谈谈影响吗？未来几周几个月锁定期情况如何，这只权益资产可能面临多大压力？

segments.en: Yes, so that's a great point. I mean, the float is like 7% and you will have a lot of restricted stocks that will have a lock up expiration and look, you know, they have a lot of convertible
segments.zh: 是的，好观点。流通盘约7%，会有很多受限股锁定期到期，而且他们有很多可转换

segments.en: debt. I think if I had to find one negative, it is around that convertible debt and how much it's going to add in terms of, you know, new share accounts. So from that perspective,
segments.zh: 债务。如果找一个负面因素，就是可转换债务，以及它会增加多少新股。从这个角度，
